answer_1.quote: CMB-Clin is designed to investigate models' proficiency in knowledge application amidst real-life diagnosis and treatment circumstances.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include answers to multiple-choice questions and multi-turn dialogue responses to complex clinical diagnostic questions.

answer_2.quote: We adopt accuracy as our metric.

answer_3.quote: we leverage GPT-4 to assess the responses of all models, adhering to the same guidelines as those used in expert evaluations.
methods: automatic evaluation using GPT-4 as a judge

answer_4.quote: we engage three annotators with professional medical knowledge to evaluate on a randomly selected subset of 320 responses of 11 models from different tiers.
answer_4.guideline: Equipped with a reference solution, they score each response across four aspects - Fluency, Relevance, Completeness, and Medical Proficiency - using a grading scale from 1 to 5.
